mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_memory_state(tenant_id,owner_id) VALUES(#{owner.tenantId},#{owner.userId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE owner_id=user_memory_state.owner_id
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM user_memory_entry WHERE AND status IN ('PENDING','ACTIVE','DISABLED') ORDER BY created_at,memory_id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM user_memory_entry WHERE AND memory_id=#{id}
SELECT command_id,memory_id,action,request_hash,revision,generation,created_at FROM user_memory_command WHERE AND idempotency_hash=#{key}
mapper.update: UPDATE user_memory_entry SET category=#{category},content=#{content},status='PENDING',retention_days=#{days}, expires_at=TIMESTAMPADD(DAY,#{days},UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)),version=version+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE AND memory_id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND status IN ('PENDING','ACTIVE','DISABLED')

UPDATE user_memory_entry SET status=#{status},version=version+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) ,expires_at=TIMESTAMPADD(DAY,retention_days,UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) ,content=NULL WHERE AND memory_id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND status IN ('PENDING','ACTIVE','DISABLED')
UPDATE user_memory_entry SET status='FORGOTTEN',content=NULL,version=version+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE AND status IN ('PENDING','ACTIVE','DISABLED')
